name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Pulsing placeholder for content that is loading, sized through classes.

props.name: shape
props.description: 6px rounded corners, or a full circle for avatars.

props.name: class
props.description: Placeholder size, for example h-4 w-1/2 or size-12.

a11y: Every skeleton is aria-hidden, so screen readers do not announce empty boxes.
Wrap a group of skeletons in role status with sr-only text such as Loading profile.
The pulse animation is turned off under prefers-reduced-motion.

ai.whenToUse: Holding the place of loading content so the layout does not shift.
rules: Match the shape and size of the real content
Use shape circle for avatars, not the rounded-full class
Add sr-only text to the wrapper so the loading state is announced

id.description: Placeholder berdenyut untuk konten yang sedang dimuat, ukurannya diatur lewat class.

props.shape: Sudut membulat 6px atau lingkaran penuh untuk avatar.
props.class: Ukuran placeholder, misalnya h-4 w-1/2 atau size-12.

a11y: Setiap skeleton aria-hidden, jadi pembaca layar tidak membacakan kotak kosong.
Bungkus grup skeleton dengan role status dan teks sr-only seperti Memuat profil.

ai.whenToUse: Menahan tempat konten yang sedang dimuat agar layout tidak bergeser.
rules: Bentuk dan ukuran skeleton meniru konten aslinya
Pakai shape circle untuk avatar, bukan class rounded-full
Tambahkan teks sr-only di pembungkus agar status memuat tetap terbaca
